config.title: Threat Analysis Configuration
config.perElementDesc: Analyzes each DFD element individually. Best for closed systems, safety-critical systems, and regulatory compliance.
config.perInteractionDesc: Analyzes data flows between components. Best for web applications, APIs, and distributed systems.
config.methodChangeWarning: Changing the STRIDE method will regenerate all threats. Existing customizations will be lost.
config.customThreatsInfo: Add custom threat templates to the catalog.
config.customMitigationsInfo: Add custom mitigation templates to the catalog.
config.customVerificationsInfo: Add custom verification templates to the catalog.
config.zeroTrustModeDesc: Generate threats from both sender AND receiver perspective for every data flow. Default: sender perspective only (+ receiver for cross-boundary flows).
config.showThreatActorDesc: Display the Threat Actor column in threat tables. Default off — actor has limited value for likelihood assessment.
